description: This source file defines the internal class AsyncTimer which implements IAsyncTimer. It manages asynchronous timer operations, including scheduling, overshoot detection, health checks, and cancellation. The class uses async/await, task delays, and logging to handle periodic timer callbacks reliably within the Orleans runtime.

classes.name: AsyncTimer
classes.description: An internal class that implements an asynchronous timer, supporting customizable delays, overshoot detection, health checks, and cancellation functionalities within Orleans.

methods.name: NextTick
methods.description: Returns a task that completes after the specified delay or when cancelled, updating internal expected firing time and handling overshoot logging.

methods.name: CheckHealth
methods.description: Checks if the timer has fired as expected, providing a reason when the health check indicates a problem due to overshoot.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Cancels the timer's operations and resets the expected firing time.
